sentences.en: I can spot a bleached blonde from a mile away.
sentences.zh: 我一眼就能看出漂染过的金发碧眼。

sentences.en: Blondes earn 7% more than women with any other hair color.
sentences.zh: 金发女郎的收入比其他头发颜色的女性高出7%。

sentences.en: I cannot believe you used to be blonde and tanned.
sentences.zh: 你竟然曾经是金发棕肤的，我简直不敢相信。

senses.zh: 亚麻色的；金色的；白皙的；白肤金发碧眼的
